VsJiraTicketTooltip.Settings.Category.De: Settings for the Jira Ticket Tooltip extension.
VsJiraTicketTooltip.Settings.IsEnabled.D: When enabled, Jira ticket identifiers (e.g. ABC-123) in code comments will show a CodeLens with the ticket title.
VsJiraTicketTooltip.Settings.JiraInstanc: The base URL of your Jira instance (e.g. https://mycompany.atlassian.net). Must be HTTPS.
VsJiraTicketTooltip.Settings.OAuthClient: The OAuth2 Client ID from your Atlassian Developer Console app.
VsJiraTicketTooltip.Settings.ActiveProvi: The ticket provider to use. Currently only Jira is supported.
VsJiraTicketTooltip.Settings.ProjectPref: Comma-separated list of project prefixes to recognize (e.g. PROJ, PR, AMU). Leave empty to match all patterns [A-Z]+-[0-9]+.
